name: DEADBOLT Governance MCP
description: 2-hop AST blast-radius lease planner, slop-breaker policy floor, SHA-256 cryptographic audit chain verifier, and staged PR gate MCP server (kruschdev/deadbolt v0.1.0). Local work-order hydration requires review; 2-hop AST blast-radius mapping and audit-chain verification inherit Guard policy; reconciliation checks and verified stage apply/PR dispatch require review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use deadbolt_map_blast_radius and deadbolt_verify_audit_chain to inspect 2-hop AST dependency cones and SHA-256 audit ledgers without mutating state.
Pass runCrossModel=false on deadbolt_validate_reconciliation when you want deterministic local invariant checks without external model referee calls, and keep deadbolt_apply_verified_stage on Review.
